y-m-69-07.title: Amaphoyinti asesikhaleni alingana ibanga ukusuka emaphoyinteni amabili enza isimo sini?
y-m-69-07.topic: Amaphoyinti alingana ibanga emaphoyinteni amabili ezixhumanisini zesikhala
y-m-69-07.goal: Yenza izibonelo ukuze ubone ukuthi ulwazi lwepulani (amaphoyinti alingana ibanga emaphoyinteni amabili enza umugqa) lushintsha kanjani esikhaleni, bese wahlulela isimo ngokuhlola ukuthi amaphoyinti owenzile alala emgqeni owodwa yini.
y-m-69-07.material: Epulani, amaphoyinti alingana ibanga emaphoyinteni amabili A no-B enza i-perpendicular bisector (umugqa) wocezu AB. Esikhaleni kunamaphoyinti amabili A(0, 0, 0) no-B(2, 4, 4), futhi sicabanga ngamaphoyinti P(x, y, z) anelisa PA=PB. Iyunithi yobude ishiyiwe.

y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.c: Udlulisele ulwazi lwepulani esikhaleni ngokwengeza i-coordinate eyodwa nje. Awukahloli ukuthi kunamacala amaningi amile ngqo.

y-m-69-06.material: Umfula ugeleza ngokuqhubekayo uye empumalanga ngo-3 m/s (inyakatho iphezulu, impumalanga ngakwesokudla). Ibhoti lingadwetshwa nge-vector yesivinini v=(p, q) uma kuqhathaniswa namanzi (p iyingxenye yempumalanga, q iyingxenye yenyakatho, ngo-m/s), futhi isivinini salo esiphezulu singu-5 m/s, ngakho p²+q²≤25. Isivinini sangempela sebhoti uma lubonwa emhlabathini singu-v+(3, 0)=(p+3, q). Kusuka ogwini oluseningizimu, ufuna ukufinyelela endaweni esogwini olungasenyakatho ngqo ngaphesheya. Cabanga ukuthi ukugeleza komfula kuhlala kunjalo noma ngabe sikuphi nesikhathi sini.
